# Shadekin
Shadekin are naturally very curious creatures, eventually exploring our dimension, especially as they are attracted to anomalous places and phenomena, often seeking to understand such. Their homeworld originally was a tidally locked planet where they resided on the nightside. At some point during their existence this world was plunged into an adjacent dimension; They began to adapt and thus it became their new home while becoming somewhat uncommon to rare visitors to realspace.
In recent history a company known as the Void Enigma Institute (VEI) was working on advanced technology involving teleportation and exo-dimensional exploration. After a catastrophic mishap at one of their research facilities Shadekin, amongst other exodimensional dwellers were pulled into realspace in greater numbers. They found themself in a place surging with anomalous phenomena.
One in particular referred to as the “Monolith” became the center of the attention of many, seeking to understand it, to satiate their own curiosity. What they found is a sector torn by prior conflicts and mistakes of the past, resources are scarce and their own research for their curiosities sake hindered.
## Racial Features
Due to their exo-dimensional origins they have quite a few unique biological features:
- Their blood is quite different from that of most other species, being difficult to clot due to its unique composition, and taking longer to replenish if lost. Shadekin receive [color=#ffa500]100% more bloodloss damage and heal bloodloss damage 75% slower[/color]. - Due to their unique body composition, they are more resistant to genetic damages, [color=#1e90ff]75% less cellular damage[/color], but are weaker to radiation exposure, [color=#ffa500]30% more radiation damage[/color], and electrical shocks, [color=#ffa500]25% more shock damage[/color]. - Due to their short fur, shadekin are more resistant to cold, [color=#1e90ff]25% less cold damage[/color], but have difficulty dealing with heat, [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage[/color]. - Shadekin eyes are more susceptible to flashes, taking twice as long to recover from them. - Their eyes have adapted to their home dimension's lack of light, granting them near perfect vision in pitch black darkness. - Their fingers have short claws at their tips, letting them deal [color=red]5[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks.
## Shadekin Language and Empathy:
Shadekin language, commonly referred to as “marrish” consists of a combination of wurbles, hisses and a distinct sound that can be described as a “Marr”, similar to a “meow” of a cat. Additionally, tail and ear movement is of great importance during verbal communication. Their language is exceptionally information dense.
Most if not all Shadekin possess an intrinsic understanding of each other's intent and motives, often assisting with non-verbal communication. This mechanism is commonly referred to as Shadekin Empathy. While this “Empathy” mechanism seems like “telepathy” at first it is nowadays quite well understood: Shadekin possess denser, more functional mirror neurons and can read a lot of information on intent from one another by eye-contact, similar to how humans do albeit considerably more amplified. Species with similar expressiveness in their eyes (i.e. humans) are often said to have a somewhat easier time conversing with Shadekin, especially since Shadekin seek direct eye contact.
## Shadekin Age and Lifecycle:
Shadekin are adults at the age of 18 like every other species. After around 100 years a Shadekin stops showing any notable sign of biological aging. Common Age ranges in realspace are 18-400 years. Shadekin older than 400 years often go through extensive meditative periods, reflecting and processing their experiences to prevent long term mental degradation. Keeping a sound mind is of great importance to Shadekin, almost greater than slaking their own natural curiosity.
## Shadekin names
Shadekin often pick their name from a physical concept or psychological state they find enticing. Names like "Entropy", "Veil", "Harmony", "Joy", "Malice", "Bliss", “Devotion”, “Wanderlust” or “Knowledge” are some examples Some Shadekin take scientific concepts they learned about or know a lot about to them or professions they enjoy enacting such as "Chemist", "Theta", "Higgs", "Planck", “Botanist”, “Plants” etc.
Shadekin names can be extremely broad and can consist of multiple words. In some cases there is a Shadekin with a regular name such as "John" but it is not unreasonable if the name has a meaning to the kin in question. Names and concepts from obscure languages other species used are also quite popular with Shadekin, i.e. human babylonian culture or Lizard/Unathi ancient linguistics. Lastly, sometimes a Shadekin mother imparts either their name or a name of their choice onto their off-spring which often becomes part of their moniker.
## Eye color and their perceived significance:
Shadekin Eye colors are often associated, almost stereotyped with personality traits. While there are complex psychological and biological factors during a Shadekins development that show certain personality and physical traits manifest in certain eye colors more frequently the associate of eye color to behavior is quite often just that: Stereotypes. Genetically, eye-colors are always inherited from the mother, so a Shadekin hatched with purple eyes will retain purple eyes in most cases.
